<!-- OPEN #282: which stamp places a bubble. Two commits rewritten in one rebase share a
         committer instant while their author instants are days apart, so the reading has to be
         chosen per view rather than assumed. -->
<!-- task #299/#304: layers 3+ are unassigned, so there is no third button to dim. -->
<!-- task #256 + OPEN #285/#289: every navigation control on one row. -->

<!-- Two rows, not one (user, 2026-07-26): the project folder is what is on DISK, and everything
       below it describes the REPOSITORY the disk state is being read against. Splitting them also
       stops #286's 88ch commit dropdown pushing the folder box off the row. -->
<!-- OPEN #295/#296: two lists, one picker. #297's button reports whether either has moved. -->
<!-- <button id="load">Load</button> -->
<!-- The title and the search box stay put while the tree scrolls under them. -->
<!-- task #326: the folder selection is only STORED until this is on; see app.js's inSelection. -->
<!-- task #254: the deselect. Shift-click folders (#255) to select more than one. -->

<!-- task #292: the project's JSONLs. Same picker behaviour as the folder tree — click filters,
           clicking the only selected one clears, shift extends. -->
<!-- task #309: the Files pane's own search control, pointed at the customTitles. -->
<!-- task #292: the wash rides behind the bubbles, the bars in front of the empty lane -->

<!-- OPEN #257 + tasks #323/#324. Row 1 = what is shown and how to step through it; row 2 = the
         diff tools, revealed only when TWO nodes are selected. The Close button stays in row 1: it
         serves every drawer mode, and moving it per-mode would make it jump around. -->
<!-- task #323: step ONE node along this file's lane. -->
<!-- task #324: the FIRST pair moves the base, the SECOND moves the target. -->

<!-- OPEN #295/#296: ONE dialog serves both lists — same widget, same rules, different title and
       different array. Fixed and centred over everything, so it is in front of the timeline. -->

<!-- task #305: the diff pair's refusal. Fixed to the viewport, not the drawer — the thing being
       refused is a click out on the timeline, which is where the reader is looking. -->
